slices.title: Emit silent context changes
slices.summary: Turns the log-only context paths (history shed, compaction outcome, skill truncation and the Do-run tool-result clearing) into counts-only context_change and compaction frames built in a new lifecycle_events module. Each occurrence emits exactly one frame, and flag-off streams stay byte-identical.
test_commands: cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib sse (tests: history_shed_emits_a_context_change_with_the_dropped_count, a_reused_summary_reports_reused_not_summarized, summarizer_outage_reports_truncated, skill_truncation_reports_counts_only, flag_off_stream_is_byte_identical)
existing, must stay green: model-gateway tests/overflow_contract.rs, tests/skill_budget_contract.rs, tests/context_recovery_contract.rs

decisions_defaults.WS15-D1 (Do-run part only; reverses the: WS-local decision: the plan's recommended default in the WS15 section

slices.title: Execution-core run-scoped handles and result_query
slices.summary: Adds a per-run in-memory handle store in execution-core that parks oversized read-class tool output and serves it back in slices through result_query; the store is capped at 1 MiB per handle and 4 MiB per run, released at finalize, and under ZDR output falls back to inline. The query logic moves into mp-contracts so the gateway and execution-core share it, and a read-class capability row lets dispatch pass the signed gate.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p execution-core result_handles
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p execution-core tool_context
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p mp-contracts result_query
slices.flag: EXECUTION_RESULT_HANDLES (execution-core; vocab C; on/off; default off)
